visual.general_description: Three stacked grayscale axial abdominal CT slices of a person, with a thin yellow arrow drawn on each slice.
visual.detailed_description: The figure is three axial CT images stacked vertically, each showing a cross-section of the abdomen with the spine at the bottom centre, both kidneys on either side of the spine, bowel gas in the anterior abdomen and a rim of subcutaneous fat; the kidneys are brighter than the soft tissue, consistent with contrast enhancement. In the top and middle images a thin yellow arrow points down and to the left from the upper right toward a rounded, homogeneous, mildly hypodense soft-tissue mass left of centre in the image, in front of the vessels and spine, between the kidneys and beneath the gas-filled bowel. The mass appears slightly larger in the middle image than in the top image. In the bottom image the slice is taken at a different level with a larger, broad, homogeneous soft-tissue band crossing the midline anterior to the aorta and spine; a yellow arrow points from the upper right to a tiny bright dot on the right side of this band, near small bright vessels. No panel letters, day labels, scale bars, measurements, annotations other than the arrows, timestamps or device text are visible.
